title: 鋼軌鋁熱焊接~Aluminothermic rail welding
focus: 現場接頭熱量收縮形貌與無損檢測~Field-joint heat shrinkage profile and nondestructive inspection
summary: 鋼軌鋁熱焊接以「現場接頭熱量收縮形貌與無損檢測」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。鋁熱焊課程只分析接頭能量、凝固收縮與焊後驗證；化學配方、點火及現場操作均不由教學模型指定，重點是辨認外觀與內部品質的差異。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops field-joint heat shrinkage profile and nondestructive inspection through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. This aluminothermic-weld course analyses joint energy, solidification shrinkage and post-weld verification; it specifies no chemical recipe, ignition or field procedure, and distinguishes visible profile from internal quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把鋼軌鋁熱焊接放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。鋁熱焊課程只分析接頭能量、凝固收縮與焊後驗證；化學配方、點火及現場操作均不由教學模型指定，重點是辨認外觀與內部品質的差異。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Aluminothermic rail welding in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. This aluminothermic-weld course analyses joint energy, solidification shrinkage and post-weld verification; it specifies no chemical recipe, ignition or field procedure, and distinguishes visible profile from internal quality. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=6.864 kg。模型邊界：有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=500 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=1500 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=1650 kJ。模型邊界：給定金屬質量、定比熱及均勻溫升；相變潛熱另算；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.864 kg. Boundary: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=500 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=1500 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=1650 kJ. Boundary: Given metal mass, constant heat capacity and uniform temperature rise; phase-change latent heat is separate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 接頭金屬質量~Joint metal mass
units.title: 接頭金屬質量~Joint metal mass
units.mechanism: 密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。本模型把 rho 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.864 kg。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料。使用接頭幾何與有效體積作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.864 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded. Use joint geometry and effective volume as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=6.864 kg。模型邊界：有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.864 kg. Boundary: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以接頭幾何與有效體積區分模型與觀察，先用接頭模型三維體積、密度資料及獨立秤重建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「接頭金屬質量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use joint geometry and effective volume to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using three-dimensional joint-model volume, density data and independent weighing, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Joint metal mass. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量。這個失效與「接頭金屬質量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接頭幾何與有效體積，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill. This failure and a measurement bias in Joint metal mass can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check joint geometry and effective volume rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill.
units.practice: 重算「接頭金屬質量」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量造成偏離的合成觀察，以接頭幾何與有效體積說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Joint metal mass, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill. Explain which evidence in joint geometry and effective volume distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 接頭顯熱量級~Joint sensible-heat scale
units.title: 接頭顯熱量級~Joint sensible-heat scale
units.mechanism: 顯熱只描述溫度變化，凝固潛熱必須另列。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1650 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。給定金屬質量、定比熱及均勻溫升；相變潛熱另算。使用質量與溫度歷程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Sensible heat describes temperature change; latent heat of solidification is separate. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1650 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Given metal mass, constant heat capacity and uniform temperature rise; phase-change latent heat is separate. Use mass and temperature history as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=500 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=1500 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=1650 kJ。模型邊界：給定金屬質量、定比熱及均勻溫升；相變潛熱另算；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=500 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=1500 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=1650 kJ. Boundary: Given metal mass, constant heat capacity and uniform temperature rise; phase-change latent heat is separate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以質量與溫度歷程區分模型與觀察，先用合成金屬溫度歷程、有效質量及熱容量紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「接頭顯熱量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use mass and temperature history to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間。這個失效與「接頭顯熱量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查質量與溫度歷程，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration. This failure and a measurement bias in Joint sensible-heat scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check mass and temperature history rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「接頭顯熱量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出給定金屬質量、定比熱及均勻溫升；相變潛熱另算如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間造成偏離的合成觀察，以質量與溫度歷程說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Joint sensible-heat scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Given metal mass, constant heat capacity and uniform temperature rise; phase-change latent heat is separate. units.title: 凝固潛熱帳~Solidification latent-heat account
units.mechanism: 相變放熱可以在溫度變化很小時持續發生。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1485 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。全部指定質量完成同一相變；潛熱視為常數。使用冷卻曲線平台作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把平台當成感測器故障會漏掉相變效應，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Phase-change heat can be released while temperature changes little. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1485 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. The specified mass completes the same phase change; latent heat is constant. Use a plateau in the cooling trace as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mistaking a plateau for sensor failure misses phase-change behavior; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=5 kg, latent=270 kJ/kg；y=m*latent=1350 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=1485 kJ。模型邊界：全部指定質量完成同一相變；潛熱視為常數；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=5 kg, latent=270 kJ/kg; y=m*latent=1350 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=1485 kJ. Boundary: The specified mass completes the same phase change; latent heat is constant; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以冷卻曲線平台區分模型與觀察，先用合成冷卻曲線、相變比例與熱量收支建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「凝固潛熱帳」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use a plateau in the cooling trace to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic cooling trace, transformed fraction and heat balance, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Solidification latent-heat account. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

This failure and a measurement bias in Solidification latent-heat account can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check a plateau in the cooling trace rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「凝固潛熱帳」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出全部指定質量完成同一相變；潛熱視為常數如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把平台當成感測器故障會漏掉相變效應造成偏離的合成觀察，以冷卻曲線平台說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Solidification latent-heat account, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: The specified mass completes the same phase change; latent heat is constant. units.title: 體積收縮量~Volume-shrinkage estimate
units.mechanism: 總收縮量不能單獨決定縮孔位置，補縮路徑與冷卻次序也重要。本模型把 V 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 cm3。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。體積收縮率是明列的整體假設；結果不決定縮孔位置。使用內部孔隙分布作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Total shrinkage does not determine pore location; feeding paths and cooling order matter. In this model, V is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.4 cm3. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Volumetric shrinkage fraction is an explicit bulk assumption; the result does not locate shrinkage voids. Use distribution of internal voids as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=800 cm3, frac=0.03 1；y=V*frac=24 cm3。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=26.4 cm3。模型邊界：體積收縮率是明列的整體假設；結果不決定縮孔位置；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=800 cm3, frac=0.03 1; y=V*frac=24 cm3. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 cm3. Boundary: Volumetric shrinkage fraction is an explicit bulk assumption; the result does not locate shrinkage voids; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以內部孔隙分布區分模型與觀察，先用模型凝固前後體積、內部缺陷影像及補縮路徑圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「體積收縮量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use distribution of internal voids to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model before-after volumes, internal-defect images and feeding-path diagram, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Volume-shrinkage estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷。這個失效與「體積收縮量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查內部孔隙分布，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect. units.verify: 本單元以接頭連續縱向掃描區分模型與觀察，先用連續輪廓掃描、標距及重複掃描的定位誤差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「焊頂輪廓坡度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use continuous longitudinal scans across the joint to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.title: 檢測掃描間距~Inspection scan spacing
units.mechanism: 掃描速度除量測頻率給出沿程點距，細點距仍不保證可檢出。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.55 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。速度與取樣率恆定且時間同步；不含聲束寬度及漏測。使用編碼器與取樣時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Scan speed divided by acquisition rate gives spatial spacing, though fine spacing alone does not guarantee detection. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.55 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Speed and sampling rate are constant and synchronized; beam width and missed acquisitions are excluded. Use encoder positions and sampling timestamps as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 mm/s, f=100 Hz；y=v/f=0.5 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.55 mm。模型邊界：速度與取樣率恆定且時間同步；不含聲束寬度及漏測；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 mm/s, f=100 Hz; y=v/f=0.5 mm. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.55 mm. units.verify: 本單元以編碼器與取樣時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用編碼器位置、逐點時間戳與實際取得資料的點數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢測掃描間距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use encoder positions and sampling timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Inspection scan spacing. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符。這個失效與「檢測掃描間距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查編碼器與取樣時間戳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
